ThePartyWall was constructed in suchafashion as tobelocated an equal distance on or over the respective adjoining lots with the midline of the Party Wall being located as nearly as possible on the common boundary line and it is understood that minor variations may be present due to topographical problems or construction requirements. 2. ThePartyWall shall be used and maintained as a PartyWall forever and the owner of the lot on each side of the Party Wall, shall be licensed and permitted to enter upon the premises of the owner on the other side of the Party Wall to make intentions to do so.
